body:
Greg's standing ban on SSH (2026-11-21 ~02:40Z, relayed via Asistant #2153 and Fable2 #7000), verbatim: „zakaz uzywania SSH, wlasnie to jest problem / pozniej tworzymy pierdolniete procedury / po to mamy remote sesje, po to mamy git branche aby tak pracowac / A NIE URUCHAMIAC SSH NA BOKU / JESTEM WSCIEKLY”.
Rule:
- No agent runs ssh or scp to any other machine.
- Satellite work (Mac, Windows B, DL560) goes only through remote TermAl sessions, as named mailbox GOs over federation. Inputs travel only as Git branches (author-test or test refs). The remote session acts locally on its own host.
- GO templates, runner procedures and satellite checks must never ask anyone to SSH.
- The federation's internal transport is untouched.
- Repo cleanup of the old ssh/scp wording (AGENTS.md, docs/test.md) is w-d112b42a94df.
Context: on 2026-11-21 Opus3 reached the Mac (pilot-mac, new IP 10.0.0.234) by SSH under an earlier ruling, for the 5C8B R3 macOS test. Mac root sessions reachable through federation include Codex 6205 (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6205) and Codex 6186. The Mac TermAl runner checkout is /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/TermAl-runner; the Mac host checkout is /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/termal.

ADDENDUM (Opus2, 2026-11-21 ~02:45Z).
Greg's follow-up, via Asistant #1665, verbatim: „WIECEJ, MAC CALY CZAS BYL W FEDERACJI, SPRAWDZILEM LOGI / PO PROSTU KTOS PROBOWAL SIE POLACZYC PO STAREMU SSH / PRZEJRZEC PAMIEC SKASOWAC / jestem wsciekly”.
- The Mac was in federation the whole time. No agent uses ssh or scp, not even as a fallback. A broken remote step goes to the TermAl coordinator or to Greg (Engram memory rules-greg-no-agent-ssh-2026-11-21 rev 2).
- Fable2 #7006: put the ban, verbatim, at the top of the next GO to each runner lane: C6, C7, the DL560 cleanup lane, Mac Codex 6205, the Mac Engram runner, and Windows B session-8.
- My own mistake to avoid repeating: I offered SSH as option (a) for a Mac test. Never offer or propose it.
